name: Mama ★ Camp ~Mama to Issho ni Shizen e Kaerou~
original_name: ママー★きゃんぷ ～ママと一緒に自然へかえろう～
source: Shouichi, who lost his mother at a young age, lives with his father. One day his father remarries a woman named Yuuko, who is young enough to be his sister, and Shouichi struggles to accept her. To improve their relationship, Yuuko suggests they attend a week-long camp event aimed at improving communication between parents and children. She joins Shouichi in attending the camp, and the story follows their journey at the event, exploring whether Shouichi can come to accept Yuko as a mother figure and how the experience will change him.
translation: 翔一自幼丧母，与父亲生活在一起。有一天，他的父亲与一位名叫优子的女人再婚，她很年轻，可以成为他的妹妹，庄一很难接受她。为了改善他们的关系，优子建议他们参加为期一周的夏令营活动，旨在改善父母和孩子之间的沟通。她与庄一一起参加夏令营，故事讲述了他们在活动中的旅程，探索庄一是否能够接受优子作为母亲的形象，以及这次经历将如何改变他。
